source.author: stat
source.text: non secus obiectas acies turbamque minorem dissimulat transitque manu; tamen ora Thoantis, pectora Deilochi, Clonii latus, ilia torvi perforat Hippotadae; truncis sua membra remittit interdum galeasque rotat per nubila plenas.
source.text_original: non secus obiectas acies turbamque minorem / dissimulat transitque manu; tamen ora Thoantis, / pectora Deilochi, Clonii latus, ilia torvi / perforat Hippotadae; truncis sua membra remittit / interdum galeasque rotat per nubila plenas.
source.text_english: No differently he pretends not to see the opposing battle line and the lesser crowd, and passes through them by hand; yet he pierces the face of Thoas, the breast of Deilochus, the side of Clonius, the flanks of the grim Hippotades; now and then he sends back their own limbs to their stumps, and whirls helmets full of heads through the clouds.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tum validam contorto turbine portam impulit Hippotades.
reuse.text_original: tum validam contorto turbine portam / impulit Hippotades.
reuse.text_english: Then Hippotas’ son drove against the stout gate with a whirling blast.
